## Win-back lapsed customers
Runs every Monday at 10:00, loads the last year of orders from the WooCommerce REST API and finds customers whose last paid order is older than `lapsedDays` (default 90). Each one gets a single WhatsApp template or email with your coupon, and is not contacted again for `cooldownDays` (default 180).
Create the coupon in WooCommerce first, edit Config, assign the credentials and create the "Win-back Log" sheet tab.
